record.original_question: The moduli space M^BGGG_{P_1} of irreducible SU(2)^2 x U(1)-invariant G2-instantons on the BGGG manifold is non-compact. Can this moduli space be compactified, and what bubbling behavior occurs as one or both of the parameters f_1^+ and g_1^+ tend to infinity? In particular, does one obtain bubbling phenomena analogous to those proved for the Bryant-Salamon case, possibly related to anti-self-dual instantons on Taub-NUT?

evidence.quote: Theorem 7. The moduli space M^BGGG_{P_1} of irreducible SU(2)^2 x U(1)-invariant G2-instantons with gauge group SU(2) on the BGGG metric, smoothly extending on P1, contains a nonempty (and unbounded) open set which is parametrised by U subset R^2.

Even if we can describe the moduli space M^BGGG_{P_1}, it will be non-compact so, just as in the Bryant-Salamon case, we will want to compactify it. It is therefore certainly an interesting problem to investigate the behaviour of the family of instantons from Theorem 7 when one or both of f_1^+ and g_1^+ go to infinity. We would expect bubbling phenomena as in the Bryant-Salamon case in Theorem 6, with possible relationship to the ASD instantons on Taub-NUT found in [EH01].

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let M = ℝ⁴ × S³ be equipped with the BGGG (Brandhuber–Gauntlett–Gibbons–Gubser) complete G₂-holonomy metric, which admits an isometric action of SU(2) × SU(2) × U(1). Let P₁ → M denote the principal SU(2)-bundle on which one studies SU(2)²×U(1)-invariant G₂-instantons that extend smoothly across the singular orbit. It is known that the moduli space M^{BGGG}_{P₁} of irreducible such G₂-instantons (with gauge group SU(2)) contains a nonempty unbounded open subset parametrized by an open set U ⊂ ℝ², with two real parameters f₁⁺ and g₁⁺ that may tend to infinity.

(a) Construct a natural compactification of the moduli space M^{BGGG}_{P₁}.

(b) Describe the bubbling behaviour of the family of G₂-instantons as one or both of the parameters f₁⁺ and g₁⁺ tend to infinity. In particular, determine whether the limiting bubbles correspond to anti-self-dual instantons on the Taub-NUT space (analogous to the bubbling phenomenon established for the Bryant–Salamon G₂-metric, where bubbles are ASD instantons on ℝ⁴).
artifact.status_search_result: Searches surface the foundational work on SU(2)²-invariant G₂-instantons on the BGGG and Bryant–Salamon metrics, where bubbling and removable singularity phenomena are described in the Bryant–Salamon case, and the analogous compactification/bubbling problem on the BGGG side (with conjectural relation to ASD instantons on Taub-NUT) is posed as an open question. No subsequent paper resolving the BGGG compactification and bubbling description was located.

status_evidence.title: SU(2)^2-invariant G2-instantons (Math. Ann.)
status_evidence.snippet: Systematic study of SU(2)^2-invariant G2-instantons on R^4 × S^3 with the Bryant–Salamon and BGGG metrics; bubbling and removable singularity for BS case.
status_evidence.claim: The BS-case bubbling is established; analogous BGGG compactification raised as a problem.

status_evidence.snippet: ASD instantons on Taub-NUT and other ALF spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Provides the conjectured target objects (Taub-NUT ASD instantons) for BGGG bubbles.
